dialogue.content: お疲れ様です。本日はよろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Thank you for being here. I look forward to working with you today.

dialogue.content: お疲れさまです。よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Thank you. I look forward to working with you as well.

dialogue.content: では、時間になりましたら始めますね。
dialogue.English: Well then, our time has started, so let's begin.

dialogue.content: はい。よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you.

dialogue.content: こんばんは。相談員です。本日はご相談に来ていただきありがとうございます。はじめに年齢、性別、そして相談内容をおしえてもらえますか？
dialogue.English: Good evening. I'm the counselor. Thank you for coming in for a consultation today. To begin, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you would like to discuss?

dialogue.content: 49歳、女性、家族のことについて
dialogue.English: I'm 49, female, and it's about my family.

dialogue.content: 教えていただきありがとうございます。家族のことでご相談ですね。詳しく教えてもらえますか？
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing that. So you'd like to talk about your family. Could you please tell me more?

dialogue.content: 何からお話していいのか分からないのですが、
dialogue.English: I'm not sure where to begin...

dialogue.content: お話しやすいとこからで大丈夫ですよ。
dialogue.English: You can start wherever feels most comfortable for you.

dialogue.content: 昨年末に父が亡くなりました。腎臓がんだったのですが、病気のことをまったく知らされていなくて、昨年3月に手術が決まってから言われて
dialogue.English: My father passed away at the end of last year. He had kidney cancer, but I wasn't told about his illness at all. They only told me last March after the surgery had been scheduled.

dialogue.content: お父さまが亡くなったのですね。それはお辛いですね、、、
dialogue.English: Your father passed away... That must be so difficult for you.

dialogue.content: はい。手術前の主治医の話では2週間くらいの入院予定が1ヶ月半くらいに長引き体力が落ちて、すっかり痩せてしまって
dialogue.English: Yes. The attending physician told us before the surgery that it would be about a two-week hospital stay, but it ended up being a month and a half. His strength declined and he became very thin.

dialogue.content: ちょうどコロナでお見舞いも思うようにできなくて、手術をしない方がつらい思いも長く生きられたのかと思うと悔しくて
dialogue.English: Because of COVID, I couldn't even visit him as much as I wanted. It's so frustrating to think that maybe he would have lived longer and suffered less if he hadn't had the surgery.

dialogue.content: 何もしてあげられなかったことと、何も聞かされてなかったことの両方が悔しくて、
dialogue.English: I'm filled with regret, both because I couldn't do anything for him and because I wasn't told anything.

dialogue.content: たしかにそれは悔しいですね、、
dialogue.English: I can understand why that would feel so frustrating...

dialogue.content: はい。父が夢に出てきて、治療方針のことを話してる夢や、一緒に旅行してる夢をみて目が覚めて、亡くなってることに気づいて。。。
dialogue.English: Yes. My father appears in my dreams—sometimes we’re discussing treatment plans, other times we’re traveling together—and then I wake up and realize he’s gone...

dialogue.content: 先ほど手術をしなかったら長く生きれたかもしれないと言われましたが、手術をしない選択もあったのですか？
dialogue.English: You just mentioned that he might have lived longer if he hadn't had the surgery. Was that an option?

dialogue.content: 夢にもお父さまが出られて、でも目が覚めたらいないというのはきついですね、、、
dialogue.English: It must be so hard to see your father in your dreams, only to wake up and realize he's not here...

dialogue.content: 最初の説明は立ち会えてないのですが、両方の腎臓に腫瘍があって、小さくて悪性度の高い方を先に手術して、落ち着いたらもう片方を手術する予定だったと聞きました。
dialogue.English: I wasn't there for the initial consultation, but I was told he had tumors in both kidneys. The plan was to operate on the smaller, more malignant one first, and then operate on the other one once he had recovered.

dialogue.content: 腎臓の手術で、膵臓のポリープも同時に取ったみたいです。
dialogue.English: It seems they also removed a pancreatic polyp during the kidney surgery.

dialogue.content: 術後の回復が思わしくなくて入院が長引いたようです
dialogue.English: His recovery after the surgery didn't go as expected, which is why his hospital stay was prolonged.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。手術後に回復が思わしくなかったのですね、、、
dialogue.English: I see. So his recovery after the surgery didn't go well...

dialogue.content: もしも手術の前から話を聞いていたら、他の病院にセカンドオピニオンを聞いたりいろいろ最善を尽くせたのにと思うと残念で
dialogue.English: It's just so regrettable, because if I had known about it before the surgery, I could have done more, like getting a second opinion from another hospital, to ensure the best possible outcome.

dialogue.content: お話の途中にすみません、相談者さんをなんとお呼びしたらいいでしょう？
dialogue.English: I'm sorry to interrupt, but how should I address you?

dialogue.content: ルーシーでお願いします
dialogue.English: Please call me Lucy.

dialogue.content: そうですね。早く病気のことを知っていれば他の選択肢があったかもしれないですよね。
dialogue.English: I understand. If you had known about his illness sooner, there might have been other options.

dialogue.content: ルーシーさんですね。教えていただきありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Lucy, got it. Thank you for letting me know.

dialogue.content: はい。両親はもともと病院嫌いですし、昔の人なのでセカンドオピニオンという考えもないので、ただ言われるままに手術をしたという感じで。
dialogue.English: Yes. My parents have always disliked hospitals, and being from an older generation, they don’t really think in terms of getting a second opinion, so it felt like they just went along with what they were told and had the surgery.

dialogue.content: そんな大事なことを何も相談されなかったことも悔しいですし、無力な自分も悔しくて
dialogue.English: It's frustrating that I wasn't consulted about something so important, and I also feel frustrated with my own powerlessness.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。わからないとお医者さんの信じてしまいますよね。
dialogue.English: I see. When you're not sure, it's natural to put your trust in the doctors.

dialogue.content: はい。病院ってこわい所だと改めて思いました
dialogue.English: Yes. It made me realize again how frightening hospitals can be.

dialogue.content: お父さんはルーシーさんだけに病気のことを伝えなかったのですか？
dialogue.English: Did your father only keep the illness from you, Lucy?

dialogue.content: お父さんの病気の件でこわい所だと思うようになったのですね。
dialogue.English: So this experience with your father’s illness is what made you feel that hospitals can be frightening.

dialogue.content: 兄は同居しているのでもしかしたら知っていたのかも知れませんが、おそらく両親の中だけで完結していたのだと思います
dialogue.English: My brother lives with them, so he might have known, but I suspect it was something my parents kept between themselves.

dialogue.content: 祖母のときもそうでしたから
dialogue.English: It was the same with my grandmother.

dialogue.content: 父は昔の人なので、全部自分で決めて他の意見はきかないので
dialogue.English: My father was old-fashioned; he would make all the decisions himself and not listen to anyone else's opinion.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: なるほどです。
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: ルーシーさんは病気のことをどうやって知ったのですか？
dialogue.English: How did you find out about the illness, Lucy?

dialogue.content: 手術が決まってから知らされました
dialogue.English: I was informed after the surgery had been scheduled.

dialogue.content: それはお父さんから聞いたのですか？
dialogue.English: Did your father tell you that?

dialogue.content: 実家で両親から聞きました
dialogue.English: My parents told me at their house.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。実家に帰った時にということでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. So it was when you visited your parents' home?

dialogue.content: そうです。
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: では、実家に帰ってなければ病気のことは知らされなかった可能性もあったのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: So, is it possible that if you hadn't visited them, you might not have been told about his illness?

dialogue.content: いえ、手術の日が決まってから知らせようとしてたと思います。
dialogue.English: No, I think they intended to tell me after the date for the surgery was decided.

dialogue.content: 私は、その前から関わらせてほしかったです
dialogue.English: I just wish they had involved me sooner than that.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。家族のことだから病気のことを知ったときすぐに知らせてほしかったですよね。
dialogue.English: Of course. It's about your family, so you would have wanted to know as soon as they found out.

dialogue.content: 心配をかけないようにそうしたのだと思いますが、知らされないことの方がつらいです
dialogue.English: I'm sure they did it because they didn't want to worry me, but it's more painful not to be told.

dialogue.content: 取り返しがつかなくなってから知るのが1番つらいです
dialogue.English: Finding out when it's too late to do anything is the hardest part.

dialogue.content: きっと心配かけないように言わなかったのでしょうね、、、
dialogue.English: They were probably trying to keep you from worrying...

dialogue.content: どうにもならなくってしまってから知るとつらいですよね、、、
dialogue.English: It is painful to find out when there's nothing that can be done...

dialogue.content: 同じ後悔はしたくないので、母親には話してほしいです
dialogue.English: I don't want to have the same regrets again, so I want my mother to talk to me about things.

dialogue.content: そうですね。お母さんにはそのことを伝えているのですか？
dialogue.English: I see. Have you communicated that to your mother?

dialogue.content: 母親には伝えています
dialogue.English: I have told my mother.

dialogue.content: お母さんはなんて言ってましたか？
dialogue.English: What did your mother say?

dialogue.content: 母親は理解してくれてるようですが。。
dialogue.English: She seems to understand, but...

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes?

dialogue.content: ただ、兄妹そろって未婚なので子離れするタイミングを逃していて、父親が亡くなってますます子供を手元に置いておきたい。。。みたいな
dialogue.English: It's just that, since both my brother and I are unmarried, she missed the opportunity to let go. Now that my father has passed away, it feels like she wants to keep her children by her side even more... something like that.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。お父さんが亡くなって子供に関心がいくようになったのですね。
dialogue.English: I see. So after your father passed away, her attention turned to her children.

dialogue.content: ルーシーさんはそのことをどう思っているのですか？
dialogue.English: How do you feel about that, Lucy?

dialogue.content: もともと過保護なんですが、父親がしていた家の管理などを私に託すようになって。。私は将来結婚も考えているのですが
dialogue.English: She was always overprotective, but now she's started to entrust me with managing the house and other things my father used to handle. And I'm also thinking about getting married in the future.

dialogue.content: 親戚も近所の人も、私に母親のことを支えてあげて、という感じで。娘だからかも知れませんが
dialogue.English: Our relatives and neighbors also tell me things like, 'You need to support your mother.' It might be because I'm her daughter.

dialogue.content: もちろんそうするつもりですが、自分の人生のこときちんと考えたいので、そのバランスを模索しています
dialogue.English: Of course I intend to support her, but I also want to think carefully about my own life, so I’m trying to find that balance.

dialogue.content: そうですね。ずっとお母さんのそばにいるというのはできないですよね、、
dialogue.English: That makes sense. You can't stay by your mother's side forever...

dialogue.content: （すみません。もう時間ですね、、）
dialogue.English: (I'm sorry. It looks like our time is up...)

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました😊
dialogue.English: Thank you very much. 😊

dialogue.content: うまくできずにすみません。でも、勉強になりました！
dialogue.English: I'm sorry I wasn't very good at this. But it was a great learning experience for me!

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。また機会がありましたらよろしくおねがいします。
dialogue.English: Thank you very much. I hope we have the opportunity to do this again.

dialogue.content: いえ、悩みが多岐に渡っていて。。お話聞いていただき、少し整理できました。ありがとうございました(ありがとうございます)
dialogue.English: Not at all. My problems are all over the place, but talking with you has helped me sort things out a little. Thank you.

dialogue.content: こちらこそ、またよろしくお願いします😊
dialogue.English: Thank you as well. I hope to do this again. 😊

dialogue.content: はい！では、ロールプレイ終わります。
dialogue.English: Okay! Let's end the role-play now.
